_README: See RESULTS.md. Coordinates: every shape scaled to area pi. Y solutions: junction, endpoints (boundary points), angles at junction; pieces = closed polygons (boundary arcs sampled, first point not repeated). congruent_pairs = index pairs of pieces judged congruent (invariants: inertia eigenvalues, max centroid distance, corner turning angles, tol 1e-5). Y_families = traced 1-parameter solution curves (junction_path = junction along the curve; solutions = representative points incl. max non-congruence margin and congruent-pair points).
